embedding_model.origin: Microsoft MiniLM-L6 distilled, contrastively fine-tuned by UKPLab on ~1B sentence pairs for semantic search

DOC-A-MEAN.description: arithmetic mean of the document's normalised chunk vectors

DOC-B-CENTROID.description: as A, after removing exact-duplicate chunk content by content hash

DOC-C-SECTION.description: mean within each section, then equal-weight mean of section vectors

DOC-D-MULTIVECTOR.description: per-section vectors kept separate; document scores at its best section

bm25_config.statistics: full corpus — never recomputed inside routed documents
